notes.title: FALLBACK : UPRISING IS HERE!
notes.content:
Hello survivors, we're 1 year after the release of FALLBACK, and we are glad to bring you the UPRISING update! 

This "2.0" update reworks the gameplay and adds tons of content to the game, we hope you'll like it. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32805650/315fb430e09923be78f4e566a8c57331034f2cec.gif

Features : 


 A complete overhaul of the 6 classes in the game, each having its own set of skills and skilltree

 A brand-new hidden level to explore – the Abandoned Sector – in which players will have to face their greatest fears as well as fierce enemies

 The Core Levels – Each level will feature a harder alternate version (with a gloomier atmosphere, tougher and more aggressive enemies…). Find the teleporter within the base level and get ready, no more playing nice.

 New achievements to unlock – Players will be able to unlock, for instance, “The Destroyer” achievement by destroying 10 enemies, “Untouchable” by dodging 100 attacks, or even “The Savior” by freeing 100 prisoners

 And much more improvements, tweaks and bugfix to give players a better experience. 


[previewyoutube=9TaVj4ea52c;full][/previewyoutube]

We hope that players will be satisified with the changes and additions that were made listening to your feedback ːsteamhappyː

And stay strong survivors, mankind needs you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32805650/3c6b77ef7ef49e05311dc42ab55e52b400930862.gif

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
New Features
 Cinematic can now be skipped
 Added New interface for interactions
 Added support for PS4 controller
 Added support for Vsync
 Added in-game news feed 


Bug Fix 

Sentinel
 Correction of a bug allowing to kill it without launching the cinematic 
 Correction of a bug with final achievement after taking the final teleporter
 Correction of a bug that made mortars invisible
 Correction of a bug that caused insane damage values on slow roll (from 500 to 50)
 Fixed lighting AMD GPUs
 Fixed Console screens on AMD GPUs
 Fixed automatic language detection using steam settings

Convenience

Added new indication on who to speak to when you finish a boss

Balance 

 Perks costs slightly increased
 Maximum shield overcharge is now 10
 Base level modules are now required for higher-level modules to appear. 

Classes:

Technophobe: 
damage increased from 3-5 to 5-7

Seismologist: 
Shield reduced from 110-130 to 80-100
Damaged reduced from 13-15 to 12-14

Modules:

Chances to receive a legendary module reduced from 10% to 5%
Chances to receive an epic module reduced from 20% to 15%

AGILITY BOOST: 
[strike]After an attack, a successful dodge recharges your shield by [X]%[/strike]
Doing a dodge after a successful attack recharges your shield by [X]%

TANK:
[strike]Your attack recharges your shield by [X]% of your damages.[/strike]
Every [X] strikes, your attack recharges your shield by [X]% of your damages.

PREVENTIVE SHIELD:
Fixed to proc once per attack done
Charge reduced from 50/100/150% to 30/50/80% of your last attack

GOD OF WAR: 
[strike]Your max health is reduced by 90% but your damaged increase by 100/150/200%[/strike]
Your damage increases by 100/150/200% but your shield can no longer load and you can not get any more healing.

SHIELD TRANSFER:
Excess healing and excess shield transferred reduced from 50/70/100 to 20/40/60

HOLD ON:
The maximum shield is now a fixed value instead of a percentage

PREPARATION:
Shield gained reduced from 150/200/400% to 50/100/150%

Ennemies:

The Sentinel
 Now has a shield
 Reduction of damage on power roll 

Alpha experiment 
 Now has a shield

Mortar:
 Health point reduced from 150 to 100
 Main gun damage reduced from 50 to 30
 Main gun firing sequence increased from 0.3 sec to 0.5s


_____________________


Thank you for your help and support! The team is now working on the next patch (28/10). More on that very soon.
